notes.title: Version 1.2: Update Map "Home", Add new skill for Husband; New map plan
notes.notes:
Hello players, thank you for playing Don't Cheat On Me!

Please update your game first before playing, otherwise you may get kicked out of game rooms!

1. Recent two days we got a lot of feedback from our players, we decided to update Map "Home":

Remove some handrail so now you can jump down from Second Floor to Ground floor at certain places.


2. To balance the game more, we also add a new skill for Husband:

Husband now possesses 6-10 mouse traps from the beginning, he can set them up at any places he want.
If Wife or Neighbour steps on the trap, her/his location will be exposed, and she/he will be damaged and can not move for a while.
Husband can pick up triggered traps and reset them somewhere.


3. Add new visual effects for Husband when "Green Value" is maxed.

4. We also optimized some network structure code to help with the stability.

Starting from today, we will do some regular balancing updates but our main focus will be creating the 4th map for the game. In this new map, we will expand the gameplay of different characters, especially create a gameplay experience for Husband that is more interesting and challenging.

We always welcome all suggestions towards Don't Cheat On Me, and thanks again for playing Don't Cheat On Me and show us your support.

A Normal Monkey Studios
01/26/2021

notes.title: Version 1.1: Balancing and remake of Invisibility Skill
notes.notes:
Hello players, thank you for playing Don't Cheat On Me!

Please update your game first before playing!ːsteammockingː

Recent two days we got a lot of feedbacks from our players, we decided to balance the game more in these ways:

1. Increase the damage of Husband's grenade
2. Slightly increase the damage range of Husband's mop
3. QTE time will be shortened
4. A failed QTE or digging out treasure will temporarily expose your location to Husband.

We also remake the invisibility skill of Wife and Neighbour:
Now you can transform into a prop when you stand still, and you have to manually activate it.
For example, in "Home" map, you can transform into a grey sofa, you must choose where to transform wisely, otherwise Husband may easily find out that the sofa is fake.

We always welcome all suggestions towards Don't Cheat On Me, and thanks again for playing Don't Cheat On Me and show us your support.

A Normal Monkey Studios
01/23/2021
